messages.msg: Lecture 3 teaches the short Fragment, written with an empty opening and closing tag, and says it cannot take a key. Please teach the long form, Fragment imported from react with a key, when a list item renders several elements, and cite Lecture 3.
messages.resolution: Map 11 teaches <Fragment key={article.id}>, imported from react, for an item with several elements, as a Merged row of key-on-mapped-element that cites Lecture 3 (<> takes no key); the short form inside map() prints the key warning (verified).
